title: 嘉信财富配置：指数平静掩盖广泛回撤
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Lizanne Saunders joins us right now. She's chief investment strategist at Charles Schwab.
segments.zh: Lizanne Saunders现在加入我们。她是Charles Schwab的首席**策略师。

segments.en: She joins us on a day where yes, technically the Dow, the S&P, the Russell, the NASDAQ, pretty much every industry is going to be 10% or below. They're all time high, barring some major reversal in
segments.zh: 她加入我们的这一天，是的，从技术上讲，道指、标普、罗素、纳斯达克，几乎每个行业都将下跌10%或以下。它们都处于历史高位，除非在未来15分钟内出现重大逆转，Lizanne。

segments.en: the next 15 minutes, Lizanne. Is this sort of the warning that you've been giving us on this show, the idea that all this calm we've seen at the index level, that maybe that was kind of hiding some
segments.zh: 这是你一直在节目中给我们的警告吗？即我们在指数层面看到的平静，也许掩盖了表面下的一些裂痕？

segments.en: of the cracks underneath? Well, there's no question that that was the case because even coming into today, the NASDAQ as an example, hadn't had more than a 13% drawdown at the index level.
segments.zh: 嗯，毫无疑问情况就是如此，因为即使到今天，以纳斯达克为例，指数层面的回撤从未超过13%。

segments.en: We may get past that and sorry, I have a little bit of a cold. Okay. But the average member within the NASDAQ, just not including today, not on an intraday basis, its average maximum drawdown at the
segments.zh: 我们可能会超过那个水平，抱歉，我有点感冒。好吧。但纳斯达克内的平均成员，不包括今天，不是盘中，其平均最大回撤在平均成员层面是负51%。

segments.en: average member level is negative 51%. Now, that may ultimately or eventually be good news in that there's been a lot of damage done under the surface, providing maybe an opportunity for diversifiers
segments.zh: 现在，这最终可能是好消息，因为表面下已经造成了大量损害，也许为多元化市场参与者提供了寻找其他领域的机会，但我们可能还没到那一步。

segments.en: to come look for other areas, but we may not quite be there yet. Well, I mean, it's kind of interesting.
segments.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，这有点有趣。

segments.en: We kicked off the show with the last year of the longest and he kind of talked about this idea of buying into this dip and he made a lot of cases as to why primarily focused on macro conditions.
segments.zh: 我们以去年最长的一次开场，他谈到了逢低买入的想法，并提出了很多理由，主要关注宏观条件。
